basic_info.description: Welcome to 56 Pearl St - a stunning top-floor 3-bedroom, 2-bath condo tucked away on a rare and peaceful cobblestone street in the vibrant Mission Dolores. Originally built in 1909 and tastefully renovated and expanded in 2021, this home in a two-unit Edwardian blends historic charm with modern design.    A light-filled open floor plan with elegant finishes creates the ideal balance of character and comfort. Modern amenities include in-unit laundry, generous storage, additional shared laundry in the garage, and parking.    Enjoy exceptional outdoor living with a shared backyard featuring a custom mural by a local artist, and a sun-drenched rooftop deck with breathtaking panoramic city views. This will be your favorite place to relax or entertain.    Situated at the crossroads of Mission Dolores, Hayes Valley, and the Mission, this vibrant and diverse neighborhood is filled with top restaurants and eclectic shops. You're literally steps away from the Market Street, Valencia Street corridor, Whole Foods, and Safeway. This prime location also offers a commuter's dream, with BART plus multiple MUNI lines all within walking distance.    Experience the best of San Francisco living in this unique and vibrant neighborhood an extraordinary opportunity not to be missed.
